name: Lovely Day Out
source:
You play as Vered, a young woman looking for an apartment in a new place. To get familiar with her surroundings, she hires a local guide to show her around and peruse apartment options. However, her guide looks to be an attractive older man... 

[From [url=https://ghoultime.itch.io/lovely-day-out]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演Vered，一位在新地方寻找公寓的年轻女子。为了熟悉周围的环境，她聘请了一名当地导游带她四处参观并仔细研究公寓选择。然而，她的导游看起来是一位很有魅力的年长男人…… 

[来自[url=https://ghoultime.itch.io/lovely-day-out]itch.io[/url]]
